faq_heading: Homes near Dogwood Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Dogwood Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Dogwood Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: By name: a listing shows up when its description mentions Dogwood Elementary. Ask Jared to watch for nearby homes that leave the school out.

faq.q: How much do homes near Dogwood Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 44 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,427,000, townhomes $785,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Dogwood Elementary?
faq.a: For the 44 homes that sold within 1 km of Dogwood Elementary, the median time on the market was 21 days and the median sale was 96.5% of list; 7% sold above list.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Dogwood Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Erma Stephenson Elementary (0.7 km north-east), Fraser Heights Secondary (0.7 km east) and Harold Bishop Elementary (0.7 km south).

Dogwood Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 10752 157 St. It teaches grades K to 7.
Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Dogwood Elementary in the listing, then check the sold prices within 1 km of the school.
How the Dogwood Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Dogwood Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Dogwood Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 44 homes sold within 1 km of Dogwood Elementary: 30 houses and 12 townhomes. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,427,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Dogwood Elementary

19 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Dogwood Elementary in a straight line (14 elementary, 4 secondary, 1 other; 2 independent). The closest is Erma Stephenson Elementary, 0.7 km away, and the farthest on this list is Serpentine Heights Elementary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Fraser Heights Secondary (0.7 km); the nearest independent school is Pacific Academy (2.4 km). Other elementary schools close by: Erma Stephenson Elementary (0.7 km north-east), Harold Bishop Elementary (0.7 km south), Fraser Wood Elementary (1.4 km east), Holly Elementary (1.4 km west), William F. Davidson Elementary (1.7 km south). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Erma Stephenson Elementary, 0.7 km north-east of Dogwood Elementary.
